svg.text: Product Units in Context of Use: 3-Zone Covert Split-Pod Architecture
Separates the fist-sized tree sensor head from the moss-buried battery/compute vault for maximum burglary & tamper survival.
FOREST TRAIL MOUNTING CONTEXT
Camera angled 25 deg obliquely down approach path (45m FOV)
GROUND / ROOT HOLLOW (2cm Forest Moss Cover)
(Above eye line)
ZONE 1: MICRO SENSOR POD
Hammond 1591BSBK (112x62x31mm)
ZONE 2: CAMO UMBILICAL
2m Wrapped in Gear Aid Camo Form
ZONE 3: BURIED BASE VAULT
QILIPSU IP67 (285x195x130mm)
Battery + Pi 5 + Pico + Diode
3mm Armored OS2 Fiber ->
ZONE 1: Tree-Mounted Covert Micro Sensor Pod (Hammond 1591BSBK — 112 x 62 x 31 mm)
• Camouflage: Rust-Oleum Ultra-Flat Earth Brown base + Deep Forest Green bark stencil (Zero metal)
• Camera + Night Vision: Arducam IMX708 NoIR + 940nm invisible IR array behind black neoprene baffle ring
• 24 GHz FMCW Radar: HLK-LD2450 shoots straight through unpainted/non-metallic ABS front wall (no hole needed)
• Anti-Theft Advantage: Fist-sized (<4.5 in) pod tucked into bark crevice 2m up; zero LEDs, zero noise, zero RF Wi-Fi
ZONE 2: Concealed Trunk Umbilical (1.8 m – 2.2 m Along Natural Bark Groove)
• Bundled Harness: Flexible camera ribbon + 4-wire radar UART (5V/GND/TX/RX) + 12V switched IR LED pair
• Concealment: Wrapped in Gear Aid Camo Form (self-clinging matte fabric tape — zero sticky residue, zero shine)
• Advance Trigger Line (At Ground Level): QMC5883L magnetometer (<1.5m I2C) + SM-24 geophone (40–60m twisted pair)
ZONE 3: Moss-Buried Base Vault (QILIPSU IP67 — 285 x 195 x 130 mm in Root Hollow)
• Primary Power: ExpertPower 12V 12Ah AGM Battery -> Littelfuse 0FHA0030XP Inline Holder (5A Blade Fuse)
• Domain A (Always-On <2 mA): Adafruit MPM3610 5V Buck -> Pico 2 Gatekeeper + QMC5883L + ADS1115 16-bit ADC
• Domain B (High-Side Switched +12V): Adafruit STEMMA Relay (GP15) -> 12V-to-5V 5A Buck Converter
• Compute & AI: Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB) + Active Cooler + Hailo-8L NPU + Official Pi 5 J5 RTC Battery
• Physics-Enforced Optical Data Diode (5V DC Barrel Powered Media Converter):
- Converter #1 Optical TX (1310nm, -3 dBm) -> 1x2 Single-Mode 50/50 SC/UPC PLC Optical Splitter Input
- Splitter Output 1 (-6.8 dBm) -> Converter #1 Optical RX (Local Loopback satisfies 1000BASE-LX FEFI!)
- Splitter Output 2 (-6.8 dBm) -> SC/UPC Coupler -> 3mm Armored OS2 Fiber exiting bottom M20 IP68 gland
• Condensation Control: M12 ePTFE pressure-equalizing breather vent + parallel PTC lens heater (t=0.25..4.25s)
